name: Malkam
title: Descendant of Benjamin
summary: Malkam is a person mentioned in the Bible, primarily in genealogies. He is known as a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in 1 Chronicles. The name Malkam means 'their king' and also appears as a reference to the Ammonite idol Milcom.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Malkam is listed as one of the sons of Shaharajim and his wife Hodesh, born in the land of Moab.

keyEvents.title: Benjamin's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Malkam belongs to the tribe of Benjamin, one of the twelve tribes of Israel, and his genealogy is recorded in Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Shaharajim's Family in Moab
keyEvents.description: Shaharajim, Malkam's father, had children in the land of Moab after he sent away his former wives Hushim and Baara.

keyEvents.title: Benjamin's Descendants Settle
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Benjamin, including Malkam's lineage, settled in various regions and played a role in Israel's tribal structure.
